description: Number of input tokens consumed by the model during the benchmarked workflow run.
Number of output tokens generated by the model during the benchmarked workflow run.
Number of output tokens the model spent on internal reasoning during the benchmarked workflow run, where the provider reports it separately. Billed as output and included in output_tokens.
Total number of AI/agent calls made during the benchmarked workflow run.
Timestamp when the AI agent begins processing the workflow task being benchmarked.
Timestamp when the AI agent completes processing the workflow task being benchmarked.
Total seconds of agent activity across all observed AI/agent calls during the benchmarked workflow run.
Model input-token price per one million tokens used for the benchmarked agent/model.
Model output-token price per one million tokens used for the benchmarked agent/model.
Timestamp when the benchmarked workflow run started.
Timestamp when the benchmarked workflow run ended.
Reviewer-assessed quality grade for the agent output using the agreed AMI grading scale.
Name of the workflow being benchmarked.
Short description of the workflow being benchmarked and the business work it performs.
Category the workflow declares itself into, from the AMI workflow category vocabulary. Decides which other workflows this run may be compared against.
The countable thing this workflow produces or processes, named by the workflow itself - a ticket, a CV, a support email.
How many work units this run handled. Gives cost and duration a denominator so they can be compared against workflows of a different size.
Name of the AI model or agent configuration being benchmarked.
Provider of the AI model or agent being benchmarked.
Platform or runtime used to execute the AI model, agent or workflow.
Workflow-defined stage or phase active when an AI or agent call occurred.
Confidence/provenance marker for workflow_stage assignment.
AMI-observed execution phase assigned from external runtime behaviour when workflow_stage is unavailable.
Confidence/provenance marker for observed_execution_phase assignment.
Basis used for an Agent Effort Profile row, such as Declared Workflow Stage or Observed Execution Phase.
Count of observed agent calls within one run_id and declared workflow_stage or observed_execution_phase.
Sum of input_tokens within one run_id and declared workflow_stage or observed_execution_phase.
Sum of output_tokens within one run_id and declared workflow_stage or observed_execution_phase.
Number of reasoning tokens attributed to an Agent Effort Profile row, where the provider reports it separately.
Sum of stage_input_tokens and stage_output_tokens within one run_id and declared workflow_stage or observed_execution_phase.
Earliest agent_start_time within one run_id and declared workflow_stage or observed_execution_phase.
Latest agent_end_time within one run_id and declared workflow_stage or observed_execution_phase.
Elapsed seconds between stage_start_time and stage_end_time within one run_id and declared workflow_stage or observed_execution_phase.
